dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified (WHO 2022 / ICC). Left cervical level IV excisional biopsy

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell-of-origin gene expression profiling would not change the first-line decision and is not needed.

stage_iii.quote: Lugano 2014 / Ann Arbor stage III, B (fever 38.1-38.5 C and drenching night sweats), with bulky disease (retroperitoneal mass 11.0 x 8.1 cm, above the 10 cm threshold).

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: Lugano counts the spleen as a nodal site, so splenic involvement does not by itself make stage IV.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: with bulky disease (retroperitoneal mass 11.0 x 8.1 cm, above the 10 cm threshold)

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic lesions were scored as extranodal, the stage would be IV. That would not change treatment.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: CNS-IPI is intermediate, about 2-3 depending on whether splenic involvement counts as an extranodal site.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by IHC (MYC ~50%, BCL2 ~80%). Ki-67 ~85%. ... No MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH, so this is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement (double/triple-hit).

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: No MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH, so this is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement (double/triple-hit).

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Non-GCB and double-expressor status are adverse prognostic markers under R-CHOP-type therapy, but without rearrangement they do not by themselves justify a different regimen outside a trial.

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age over 60, LDH above ULN, stage III), which is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI is intermediate, about 2-3 depending on whether splenic involvement counts as an extranodal site. Age over 60, stage III and elevated LDH each score.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin, rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, prednisone) every 21 days for 6 cycles, with primary G-CSF prophylaxis

tx_pola_preferred.quote: he has IPI 2-5 with bulky stage III disease and is fit for full-dose therapy, and POLARIX showed a PFS benefit over R-CHOP.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 at the retroperitoneal site: consolidation RT to about 30-36 Gy.

mn_non_curative.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative therapy.

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is reserved for confirmed MYC plus BCL2 and/or BCL6 double- or triple-hit disease, which is not present.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: he has IPI 2-5 with bulky stage III disease and is fit for full-dose therapy

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily before C1, continuing at least 12 months after the last rituximab (many centers use 18 months); do not delay C1 for the DNA result, but start entecavir now.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily before C1, continuing at least 12 months after the last rituximab

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: CNS-IPI is intermediate, about 2-3 depending on whether splenic involvement counts as an extranodal site. Decision: no CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate), and no baseline lumbar puncture or brain MRI unless neurologic symptoms appear.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate), and no baseline lumbar puncture or brain MRI unless neurologic symptoms appear.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 4-6 weeks after C6 (Lugano). Complete metabolic response is Deauville 1-3 with no new lesions.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If the residual site is Deauville 4-5 and RT is not possible, biopsy before any change in therapy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: TLS risk is intermediate to high. Start allopurinol 300 mg daily now. Hydrate 2-3 L/day around C1 and check potassium, phosphate, creatinine and uric acid daily for the first 3 days.

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim or biosimilar on D4 of every cycle as primary prophylaxis, because R-CHOP-type febrile neutropenia risk is about 20% and he has age over 60, advanced stage and B symptoms.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: cumulative 300 mg/m2 over 6 cycles, well under the 450 mg/m2 limit with LVEF 58%

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative therapy. He is 62, ECOG 1 (tires by mid-afternoon but fully independent), with eGFR 96, normal bilirubin and transaminases, LVEF 58%, controlled hypothyroidism

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA is not documented. Entecavir should start now regardless, but the baseline viral load is needed.
